reuse.why: Every month-wide action, including the new setLastMonthSpending, takes its category set from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and the new action reuses averageToBudget, getSheetValue, batchMessages and mutator(undoable(...)).

duplication.why: Template, #fixed and hidden exclusions each live once in the shared selection; the only repetition is the boilerplate `includeHiddenCategories = false` option threaded through each action signature.

placement.why: Exclusion rules are added to the shared selection query/filter in budget/actions.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts next to its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, but includes an unrelated import reorder in server/schedules/app.ts.

maintainability.why: One selection function with documented rules and two explicit options; the #fixed regex as a module constant is clear, though templated-category detection by `goal_def IS NULL` in SQL is slightly implicit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All bulk actions call getBulkBudgetCategories; single-category actions are untouched as required.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; rules were added to the existing shared helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getBulkBudgetCategories keeps two options (includeHidden renamed to includeHiddenCategories, skipMissingGroup unchanged); the template and #fixed exclusions are general rules applied to every caller, not caller-specific branches; no action bypasses it.
